project.name: Darwin Overnight02 Read-Only
project.description: Narrow unattended read-only consistency inspections at the frozen Darwin reference.

tasks.title: Observability counter invariant review
tasks.objective: Review one bounded observability counter invariant and report exact consistency findings from the supplied implementation and test files.
acceptance_criteria: Findings cite exact fragments from supplied files.
The result remains a compact consistency review.

tasks.title: Research-loop state enum consistency review
tasks.objective: Compare the research-loop state declarations with their focused tests and report exact naming or coverage inconsistencies.
acceptance_criteria: Every finding is grounded in the supplied schema or test files.
No state transition is inferred beyond the supplied text.

tasks.title: CLI command registration consistency review
tasks.objective: Review the declared Darwin CLI command registration and its focused CLI tests for bounded consistency findings.
acceptance_criteria: Findings cite exact CLI or test fragments.
No command is executed or changed by this task.

tasks.title: Configuration default inventory
tasks.objective: Inventory declared Darwin configuration defaults and unresolved environment assumptions from the settings and template files.
acceptance_criteria: No credentials or environment values are changed or exposed.

tasks.title: Migration and model naming consistency review
tasks.objective: Compare the research-loop migration names with the corresponding model declarations and report exact naming consistency findings.
acceptance_criteria: Findings cite exact migration or model fragments.
No migration or model is modified or executed.

tasks.title: Documentation-to-schema terminology review
tasks.objective: Compare the research-loop runtime terminology with its schema declarations and report only exact terminology mismatches or confirmations.
acceptance_criteria: Terminology findings cite exact documentation or schema fragments.
No runtime behavior is inferred beyond the supplied files.
